title: bool_true/is_true helpers: consider || literal closure
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs lines 152-158, two private helper functions bool_true() -> bool { true } and is_true(b: &bool) -> bool { *b } are defined. This is the standard pattern required by serde's default= and skip_serializing_if= attributes, which require function paths, not closures. The pattern is correct and idiomatic for serde. However, both functions are module-private (no pub/pub(crate)) but only used within the same module — this is fine. One minor style point: is_true can be written as |b: &bool| *b in newer serde but serde still requires function item paths, not closures, in attributes. No action required — this is the established serde idiom. Filing as P4 for awareness only.
